method: Shared reconciliation dictionary for the mandatory TTS pronunciation diff (agents/02-audio-producer.md). Entries are recurring Indonesian Whisper ASR artifacts observed and resolved in Episodes 003-005. `renames` map a heard ASR form to the script-faithful form (case- and punctuation-tolerant; `contextBefore` scopes a rename to the preceding heard token). `splits` divide one merged heard token into the script pair at `splitRatio` of its span. `merges` join two heard tokens into one script word. Matching is punctuation-tolerant and case-insensitive. Only deviations that stay unexplained after these entries escalate as suspects; ASR text alone never establishes pronunciation.

renames.note: Whisper colloquial-form normalization; script "nggak" (Episode 005: "Nggak mirip dia", "Nggak ada yang sempat", "yang nggak diikat").
Formal form heard for the colloquial script word "bener" (Episode 004 "bener-bener"). Reversible by design: a script that really uses "benar" escalates as a suspect instead of passing silently.
Formal form heard for the colloquial script word "jadiin" (Episode 004).
